tool.name: pmotools extract_allele_table
tool.description: Extract allele table from a PMO for tools like dcifer or moire
tool.command: pmotools-python extract_allele_table --file '$input_pmo' --output '$output_table' --delim '$delim' --overwrite $skip_validation #if $allele_freqs: --allele_freqs_output '$output_freqs' #end if #if str($specimen_info_meta_fields): --specimen_info_meta_fields '$specimen_info_meta_fields' #end if #if str($library_sample_info_meta_fields): --library_sample_info_meta_fields '$library_sample_info_meta_fields' #end if #if str($microhap_fields): --microhap_fields '$microhap_fields' #end if #if str($representative_haps_fields): --representative_haps_fields '$representative_haps_fields' #end if --default_base_col_names '$default_base_col_names'

param.name: allele_freqs
param.label: Also output allele frequencies table
param.help: If enabled, an additional tabular file with allele counts and frequencies will be produced

param.label: Specimen metadata fields to include
param.help: Comma-separated metadata field names from the specimen table to include in output

param.label: Library sample metadata fields to include
param.help: Comma-separated metadata field names from the library sample table to include in output

param.label: Microhaplotype fields to include
param.help: Comma-separated additional fields from the detected microhaplotype object to include

param.label: Representative haplotype fields to include
param.help: Comma-separated additional fields from the representative object to include

param.label: Default base column names
param.help: Must be exactly 3 comma-separated column names

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Extract Allele Table**
Extracts an allele table from a PMO file for use with downstream tools such as dcifer or moire. Each row represents a detected microhaplotype allele with its associated library sample and target.
Options:
- **Skip validation**: Skip JSON schema validation of the input PMO (faster, but no error checking) - **Allele frequencies table**: Also produce a secondary table of allele counts and frequencies - **Specimen metadata fields**: Include selected specimen metadata fields as additional columns - **Library sample metadata fields**: Include selected library sample metadata fields as additional columns - **Microhaplotype fields**: Include additional fields from the detected microhaplotype object - **Representative haplotype fields**: Include additional fields from the representative haplotype object - **Default base column names**: The three required base columns (default: `library_sample_name,target_name,mhap_id`)
